hypothesis: A cycle-consistency loss that reconstructs the source from the edited molecule under the inverse property program improves source-faithful editing without changing the P1 de-novo path.

shared_contract.task_interface: empty versus nonempty source state; EDIT condition token only on source-present rows
shared_contract.p1_de_novo_condition_layout: bit-exact base plus direct property program

evaluation.denovo: P6 frozen hard 2p-7p subset with 6p and 7p strata

r1.name: forward_only
r1.training_rows: balanced de-novo and forward edit rows

r2.name: inverse_program_cycle
r2.training_rows: identical forward rows plus inverse-program cycle rows
r2.queue_policy: afterany R1; poor R1 does not eliminate R2

interpretation.positive: R2 improves raw edit validity and/or Acc_all at k=1/8/20 while de-novo remains equal within deterministic sampling noise.
interpretation.negative: Cycle reconstruction causes copying or fails to improve edit metrics; retain as completed negative ablation rather than redefining selection.
